name: ado-search
title: Azure DevOps Repositories Search
description: Search Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, pull requests and work items, browse and plan sprint work items, create work items, and see open pull requests in the menu bar.
author: willem_van_lent

commands.name: search-ado-repos
commands.title: Azure DevOps Repositories Search
commands.description: Search and open Azure DevOps Repositories

commands.name: my-work-items
commands.title: Azure DevOps My Work Items
commands.description: Browse work items assigned to you, change states, view attachments, and create linked branches
commands.subtitle: Azure DevOps

commands.name: sprint-work-items
commands.title: Azure DevOps Sprint Work Items
commands.description: Browse the work items of a sprint as the sprint backlog shows them, grouped by User Story or state, and comment, log hours or move them to another sprint
commands.subtitle: Azure DevOps

commands.name: search-work-items
commands.title: Azure DevOps Search Work Items
commands.description: Find any work item of the project by number or by words in its title or description
commands.subtitle: Azure DevOps

commands.name: create-work-item
commands.title: Azure DevOps Create Work Item
commands.description: Create a work item of any type, optionally planned in a sprint, under a parent and with an estimate
commands.subtitle: Azure DevOps

preferences.name: defaultProject
preferences.title: Default Project
preferences.description: Project for new work items. When set, the form doesn't ask for it.

preferences.name: defaultType
preferences.title: Default Type
preferences.description: Work item type, e.g. Task. When set (and the project has it), the form doesn't ask for it.

preferences.name: defaultArea
preferences.title: Default Area
preferences.description: Area path for new work items, as shown in Azure DevOps, e.g. MyProject\MyTeam. Used when it belongs to the item's project. Leave empty to use the project's default area.

preferences.name: defaultSprint
preferences.title: Default Sprint
preferences.description: Sprint for new work items of the project set in the extension preferences. Any option other than 'Ask in the form' hides the field.

preferences.name: defaultAssignee
preferences.title: Default Assignee
preferences.description: Who new work items are assigned to. Any option other than 'Ask in the form' hides the field.

preferences.name: defaultCreateBranch
preferences.title: Create Branch
preferences.description: Whether to create a branch after the work item. Any option other than 'Ask in the form' hides the checkbox.

commands.name: search-ado-pipelines
commands.title: Azure DevOps Pipelines Search
commands.description: Search and open Azure DevOps Pipelines
commands.subtitle: Azure DevOps

commands.name: search-my-pull-requests
commands.title: Azure DevOps My Open Pull Requests
commands.description: Search and open my Azure DevOps Open Pull Requests
commands.subtitle: Azure DevOps

commands.name: search-my-pbis
commands.title: Azure DevOps My Open PBIs
commands.description: Search and open my Azure DevOps PBIs
commands.subtitle: Azure DevOps

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Azure DevOps Open Pull Requests
commands.description: Open Azure DevOps Open Pull Requests
commands.subtitle: Open Pull Requests

preferences.description: The organization name of the Azure DevOps account which you will search through
preferences.name: organizationName
preferences.title: The organization name

preferences.description: The project name of the Azure DevOps account which you will search through
preferences.name: projectName
preferences.title: The project name

preferences.description: The personal access token for the given Azure DevOps account. Don't base64 encode it, just paste it as is.
preferences.name: personalAccessToken
preferences.title: Azure DevOps PAT

preferences.description: The email address of your Azure DevOps account
preferences.name: email
preferences.title: Azure DevOps Email

preferences.description: Team whose sprints the Sprint Work Items command shows (Project Settings → Teams). Leave empty to use the project's default team.
preferences.name: team
preferences.title: Team

preferences.description: Reference name of a custom field where your team keeps the estimate in hours, e.g. Custom.EstimatedWork. When set (and the type has it), it is used instead of Original Estimate in Sprint Work Items and the work item form. Leave empty to use Original Estimate.
preferences.name: customEstimateField
preferences.title: Custom Estimate Field
